title: LiveVoiceParams
description: VibeVoice-Realtime 0.5B voice preset. file_stem matches <lang>-<Name>_<gender>.pt. Language codes in the library are de, en, fr, in, it, jp, kr, nl, pl, pt, and sp (jp, sp, kr, and in are file codes, not BCP-47). experimental is true only when the file is under experimental_voices/<lang>/. Top-level streaming_model presets are not experimental, including the non-English ones (de-Spk0_man, jp-Spk0_man, sp-Spk0_woman, kr-Spk0_woman, in-Samuel_man). preset_kind kv_cache is the serialized prefilled prompt, not a reference WAV. single_speaker is required.
